title: English Practice Quiz 0980
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A conflict of interest occurs when personal interests may ___.
questions.explanation: A conflict of interest can affect, or appear to affect, impartial decisions.

questions.question: If you discover a mistake in an official record, you should ___.
options: report it and follow the correction procedure
questions.explanation: Errors should be corrected transparently using the authorised process.

questions.question: Confidential information should be shared ___.
options: only with authorised people for a valid purpose
questions.explanation: Access should be limited to authorised people with a legitimate need.

questions.question: An impartial decision is one that is made ___.
questions.explanation: Impartial means fair and not influenced by personal preference.

questions.question: If a colleague offers a gift in return for special treatment, you should ___.
options: follow the organisation's gift and ethics policy
questions.explanation: Gifts linked to preferential treatment can create an ethical concern.

questions.question: Professional accountability means being prepared to ___.
questions.explanation: Accountability involves owning actions and explaining decisions.

questions.question: Which action demonstrates respect for workplace diversity?
questions.explanation: Respect means treating people fairly regardless of their differences.

questions.question: If you witness possible misconduct, you should ___.
questions.explanation: Appropriate reporting channels help the organisation assess concerns responsibly.

questions.question: A transparent process is one that is ___.
options: open and clear about how decisions are made
questions.explanation: Transparency makes procedures and decisions understandable.

questions.question: A professional apology should include ___.
options: acknowledgement of the issue and a sincere corrective step
a promise that cannot be kept
questions.explanation: A useful apology recognises the problem and explains how it will be addressed.
